evidence.claim: Country risk closed at 852 bps on 4 November, a 2026 high, up 65 bps in three sessions from 787 on 30 October.
evidence.numbers: Up from a 402 low in July; Argentina LNG still targets FID on 26 November.

evidence.claim: AP: Milei pitches a regulation-free AI haven; Pampa seeks developers for a gas-powered site near Vaca Muerta and Crusoe sought talks with energy officials.
evidence.numbers: Incentive of 15% income tax for $1B-plus projects awaits the Senate; some investors wait for the 2027 election.

evidence.claim: JP Morgan country risk closed at 787 bps, its 2026 high; about 779 on 2 November. Analysts say normal market access has not returned.
evidence.numbers: +80 bps on the week, +180 in October, +385 from the 402 low on 10 July. Infobae cites 791 for the same close.

evidence.claim: EXIM weighs raising its Argentina line to $10B from $7B; DFC studying about $20B, per AmCham.
evidence.numbers: Ceilings, not disbursements; $6B of the EXIM line is a non-binding LNG term sheet, and its charter expires 31 December.

evidence.claim: Bloomberg Linea: still a letter of intent, with no definitive contract and no RIGI filing as of April; site chosen in Confluencia, Neuquen.
evidence.numbers: About $18B of the $25B would be Nvidia chips, per Sur Energy.

evidence.claim: Crusoe will build its first Latin American AI cloud beside Paraguay's Itaipú substation: a path to 106 MW of IT load, options to about 280 MW, first deployment mid-2027, serving US cloud customers.
evidence.numbers: No investment or financing disclosed; a US official called it potentially Paraguay's largest private foreign investment.

evidence.claim: Country risk rose to 675 bps, the 2026 high, from 403 in July; dollar bonds fell about 5% in a month; an analyst said neither external nor domestic financing can move forward for now.
Vista's CEO pitched Vaca Muerta as a data center hub for its gas; no project named.
Country risk peaked at 655 bps on 2 October and settled near 600, seen as a floor until the 2027 election.

Super RIGI (US$1B minimum, 15% income tax, 30-year stability) passed Deputies in June and still awaits the Senate; Pampa offers about 780 MW of existing idle capacity in Vaca Muerta; Stargate Argentina still has no firm contract.
A year on, no construction, no concrete investment and no RIGI filing; OpenAI says it is only a possible buyer.
EXIM signed a framework for up to $7B through 2027 covering energy, minerals and digital connectivity.

question: Is Argentina, or Latin America, becoming investable for AI compute?
summary: Still weakening: country risk rose again to 852 bps on 4 November, a 2026 high, from 787 on 30 October and 402 in July, ahead of a 2027 election investors are waiting on. The offsets are official and not yet approved: EXIM's up to $6B LNG offer needs board approval in 2027, DFC is studying about $20B, Argentina LNG targets FID on 26 November. The region remains better than the country, with Crusoe in Paraguay; Stargate Argentina is still only a letter of intent and the Super RIGI awaits the Senate. The US midterm backlash is a relative plus for offshore sites but does not lower Argentine borrowing costs; an LNG FID or a Senate vote would argue for moving back.
title: Argentina and Latin America
